text:
Here's an easy-paced 3 days in Jaipur for your parents, with a slow start each morning and a rest after lunch.

Day 1: Forts and old city. Amer Fort early, before the crowds (a jeep up saves the steps). Stop for photos at Jal Mahal. In the evening, Hawa Mahal and a gentle walk through Johari Bazaar.
Day 2: Palaces. City Palace and Jantar Mantar in the morning. After a rest, visit Albert Hall Museum when the light is soft, then Birla Mandir at dusk.
Day 3: Relaxed day. Patrika Gate for photos, then shopping at Bapu Bazaar for bangles, textiles and sweets. Finish with a Rajasthani thali dinner.

Late October to February is the most comfortable time to go, since afternoons are warm but not harsh. Want me to check hotels or trains once you pick dates?

Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
4:32 AM

The National Museum is open Tue to Sun, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. Entry for Indian adults is ₹20. Foreign nationals pay ₹500 and students up to class 12 get in free with an I-card. The site also has a notice (dated 29 May 2023) saying the Arms and Armour, Textiles and Jewellery galleries are closed for renovation until further notice. It is worth checking whether that still applies.
